description: A hand-authored stand-in golden run (RFC-03 §5: no real pilot run exists yet) for a 6-slide carousel about process changes that measurably paid off this quarter, each slide traced to a distinct sourced fact.

rules.description: slide copy must not use hype/banned words

research.topic: process changes that actually moved the needle this quarter

facts.claim: Teams that automated their weekly reporting saved an average of 4 hours per week.
Our support team resolved 30% more tickets after switching to the new triage flow.
Clients who onboarded with the new checklist reached first value 2 days faster.
Internal surveys showed a 25% jump in team satisfaction after the process change.
The design team cut revision cycles from 5 rounds to 2 on average.
Onboarding time dropped from 14 days to 7 days after the rollout.

endorsedCopy.caption: This quarter's process changes actually moved the needle: hours back, faster onboarding, and a team that's measurably happier with how work gets done.
